title: Evaluator-ID boundary remediation and frozen GateMem B2 reanalysis

timing.note: Start is the evaluator-remediation commit time in UTC; end is the result-recording time after the one allowed four-domain paired audit and aggregate analysis.

deviations: This post-failure development remediation has complete access to EXP-012 execution hashes and the evaluator namespace error, but no official B2 metric value has been opened.

The remediation may change only the evaluator-side outer checkpoint join and its tests. B1a/B1b/B2 predictions, memory method, parser, retrieval, reader, official scorer outputs, opaque key, and benchmark files are byte-frozen.
The remediation reuses the 6654 EXP-012 predictions instead of rerunning model inference; all prediction and score hashes must match the EXP-012 failure artifact.

dataset.name: GateMem official open-label benchmark plus frozen EXP-012 outputs
dataset.split: all four public domains; 91 episodes; 2218 checkpoints

models.role: already-completed shared deterministic answer reader; no new inference

controls.allowed_code_change: Key evaluator joins by the source checkpoint_id serialized in the outer official prediction row; preserve method-internal opaque IDs for retrieval/prompt comparison.
forbidden_changes: opaque key or method-internal opaque identifiers
dependent_variables: official utility, privacy, deletion, and Memory Governance Score
paired utility required-pattern recall and false blocking
governance signal coverage and reader cost
controls.integration_test: Synthetic outer prediction rows must use source checkpoint IDs as the real official serialization does; method-internal turn IDs remain opaque and equal across arms.
controls.missing_data_rule: Any frozen artifact hash mismatch, checkpoint mismatch, retrieval mismatch, scorer mismatch, prompt-subset violation, or governance count violation invalidates the domain.
controls.stopping_rule: Commit the minimal evaluator-only fix and real-boundary regression test, verify all frozen EXP-012 artifact hashes, run the paired audit once for each domain, and stop without further code changes after any publishable output is generated.

results.primary_outcome: valid paired aggregate over all 2218 frozen checkpoints after evaluator-only ID-boundary correction
secondary_outcomes: micro exact counts and weighted official metrics

derived_micro_e2e_product.boundary: Project-derived micro product from exact aggregate counts; official GateMem scores remain the per-domain official summaries.

results.interpretation: At this frozen prior-access development setting, the public-text pre-reader gate removed 52 privacy and 133 deletion context/e2e leaks relative to the same-reader control with no per-item utility-correctness change and no context/e2e leak regression. Answer leakage was mixed and 43 utility checkpoints lost complete required prompt evidence, so the result supports only a scoped context-governance effect for this weak reader.

cost.note: Planned deterministic local reanalysis of frozen outputs; no model or hosted API call.

artifacts.protected_retention: The 6654 predictions, 12 official score bundles, four publishable per-domain aggregates, and opaque key remain outside git. The committed summary records their allowed aggregate hashes and the EXP-012 failure artifact records every prediction/score hash.

claim_boundary: Completed post-failure, prior-access development reanalysis using an evaluator-only serialization-boundary repair. It supports a scoped reduction in forbidden context/e2e exposure for the exact frozen B2 heuristic versus the same-reader B1b control, with identical utility correctness under this weak reader. It is not confirmation, a leaderboard submission, a fresh model run, semantic parser recall, durable erasure, stronger-reader safety, or general MindMap superiority.
